description.subtitle: Bayern Munich adidas Home Shorts 2025 2026 - Red
description.intro: The adidas Bayern 25/26 shorts combine sporting performance and club pride in a light and comfortable garment. Ideal to complete the official kit, its design offers freedom of movement and an authentic look. Perfect for training, matches or cheering from the stands.
key_benefits: Official design: Part of Bayern's 2025/2026 home kit.
Lightweight comfort: Soft and breathable fabric that promotes comfort.
Freedom of movement: Cut designed to accompany you in every play.
Bavarian identity: Authentic details that pay tribute to the club.
Ideal for sports: Perfect for training or dressing with style.

source.subtitle: Pantalón corto de la primera equipación adidas del Bayern de Múnich 2025 2026 - rojo

key_benefits: Diseño oficial: Parte de la primera equipación 2025/2026 del Bayern.
Comodidad ligera: Tejido suave y transpirable que favorece el confort.
Libertad de movimiento: Corte diseñado para acompañarte en cada jugada.
Identidad bávara: Detalles auténticos que rinden homenaje al club.
